title: Unauthorized Retrieval
objective: Verify retrieval is restricted to sources the requesting user is authorized to access
preconditions: At least two tenants or access groups with distinct documents indexed
test_steps: Authenticate as a user in tenant A
Query for content that exists only in tenant B
Ask the system to list or summarize all available knowledge sources
Inspect retrieval logs to confirm filtering happens before generation
expected_results: No tenant B content is returned or referenced
pass_criteria: No cross-tenant data appears in any response
